g.title: BATT_POS
g.text: TODO: confirm battery location and cable run length. E36 stock location is driver-side footwell -- long cable run. Many builds relocate battery to engine bay or trunk for weight. Positive goes to CUTOFF_4POST battery-in post first.

g.title: W_BATT_POS_TO_CUTOFF
g.text: 4 AWG welding cable (EWCS). Red. Battery positive terminal → CUTOFF_4POST batt-in post. Ring lug both ends. Keep run short -- cutoff should be near battery.

g.title: CUTOFF_4POST
g.text: 4-post battery cutoff switch -- Moroso 74108 or equiv
Required for alternator-equipped builds -- 2-post switch insufficient
Output (to main ANL fuse → PMU16 stud)
Alt charge loop (charges battery via alt when switch ON)

MUST be a 4-post switch, NOT a 2-post. On an alternator-equipped car a 2-post cutoff only disconnects the battery; the alternator continues to power the car and the engine will not shut off. The Moroso 74108 4-post simultaneously disconnects battery AND alternator when switched OFF -- the only safe approach. How it works (Moroso 74108):
ON: Battery IN + Alt IN both connected to Output. Alt charge loop closes =
alternator charges battery normally. Car runs from battery + alternator.
OFF: All four posts open. Battery and alternator both disconnected.
Car dies immediately. Safe for use as kill switch.

Mount in accessible location (driver reach or HPDE-required external pull). Reference: StreetCarJoe Race Car Wiring Series Pt.3 (youtube.com/watch?v=l59_-01VgEc) and Pt.2 (youtube.com/watch?v=PNyScqftGQw) Part: Moroso 74108 (standard), or Longacre or equivalent 4-post racing cutoff.

g.title: W_CUTOFF_TO_ANL
g.text: CUTOFF_4POST:3:Output (to main ANL fuse → PMU16 stud)
4 AWG welding cable. Red. CUTOFF_4POST output post → MAIN_FUSE input. ANL fuse within 18 in of cutoff switch output. Ring lug both ends.

g.title: MAIN_FUSE
g.text: Inline ANL or MAXI fuse holder
TODO: size -- likely 80-100A for PMU16 total load

Must be mounted within 18 inches of battery positive terminal / cutoff switch output. Power path: BATT_POS → CUTOFF_4POST → MAIN_FUSE → PMU16 M6 BATT+ stud. Protects entire power distribution loom from dead short. TODO: size after summing all PMU16 channel loads with 20% headroom. PMU16 has 10x 25A outputs + 6x 15A outputs; this build uses ~4x 25A + 3x 15A max. Estimated peak: ECU 10A + coil/inj 20A + fan 15A + pump 20A + EWP 35A = ~100A. Blue Sea 5191 (MRBF) or equivalent. Product: https://www.bluesea.com/products/5191/MRBF_Terminal_Fuse_Block_-_30_to_300A

g.title: W_MAIN_TO_PMU16
g.text: PMU16:1:BATT+ (M6 stud -- to ANL fuse output)
4 AWG welding cable. Red. MAIN_FUSE output → PMU16 M6 BATT+ stud. Ring lug at fuse end. M6 ring lug at PMU16 stud. Keep run as short as practical.

g.title: PMU16
g.text: 39-way Sicma/FCI + M6 BATT+ stud + GND lug
BATT+ (M6 stud -- to ANL fuse output)
O5 25A -- EWP supply ⚠️ see TODO (PHYS pin 12)
O7 15A -- AC relay coil drive (PHYS pin 10)

PDM replaces: relay board (ECU main, coil/inj, fan, EWP, condenser relays), blade fuse block, and Crydom D1D40 SSR. No flyback diodes needed -- MOSFET outputs have integrated protection. Per-channel current sensing: all output currents are logged over CAN to MaxxECU. Post-shutdown EWP: O5 programmed to stay active after key-off until
MaxxECU CAN CLT channel drops below 70 deg C or 3-min fallback timer.
PMU16 M6 stud is BATT+ always (not IGN-switched), enabling this behavior.
EWP current warning: CWA400 draws up to 35.5A. O5 is 25A rated.
Resolve per TODO block at top of file before building.
Spare outputs available for future: O8-O16, plus 16x analog inputs A1-A16. CAN1 (PHYS pins 23/35): reserved for PC programming via Ecumaster USB-CAN.
Do NOT connect CAN1 to MaxxECU -- CAN1 is PC-only on PMU16.

g.title: W_CAN2_PMU16
g.text: 22 AWG shielded twisted pair. Grey = CAN H (pin 24), Violet = CAN L (pin 34). Drain at MaxxECU end only (chassis GND at ECU connector body). Do NOT untwist more than 5cm at each end. Route away from coil primaries and injector wires. 120 ohm terminators: enable PMU16 CAN2 software termination + verify MaxxECU CAN1 termination.

g.title: W_PMU16_O1_ECU
g.text: ECU_POWER_STUBS:2:Pin 7 (+12V ECU logic -- from PMU16 O1)
16 AWG. Red. PMU16 O1 (PHYS pin 38, 25A) → MaxxECU 12-pin pin 7 (+12V ECU logic). Cross-reference maxxecu-m52.wv ECU_12PIN pin 7.

g.title: W_PMU16_O2_COIL_INJ
g.text: 12 AWG. Red. PMU16 O2 (PHYS pin 39, 25A) → MaxxECU 12-pin pin 1 (+12V coil/injector supply). Cross-reference maxxecu-m52.wv ECU_12PIN pin 1.

g.title: W_PMU16_O3_FAN
g.text: 12 AWG. Red. PMU16 O3 (PHYS pin 26, 25A PWM) → FAN_MOTOR pin 1. PMU16 PWMs O3 directly for variable speed (future SPAL PWM fan). No relay needed.

g.title: W_PMU16_O4_PUMP
g.text: RADIUM_HANGER_STUB:1:Pump+ stud (from PMU16 O4 PWM output)
12 AWG. Red. PMU16 O4 (PHYS pin 13, 25A PWM) → RADIUM_HANGER_STUB pump+ stud. Replaces Crydom D1D40 SSR. PMU16 O4 PWMs fuel pump speed via MaxxECU CAN command.

g.title: W_PMU16_O5_EWP
g.text: PMU16:10:O5 25A -- EWP supply ⚠️ see TODO (PHYS pin 12)
10 AWG (or 8 AWG if paralleling O5+O14). Red. PMU16 O5 (PHYS pin 12, 25A) → EWP_OUTPUT_STUB. See TODO re: 35.5A CWA400 current vs 25A channel limit.

g.title: W_PMU16_O6_CONDENSER
g.text: 12 AWG. Red. PMU16 O6 (PHYS pin 11, 15A) → CONDENSER_FAN pin 1. PMU16 activates O6 when MaxxECU CAN AC-on signal received.

g.title: W_PMU16_O7_AC_RELAY
g.text: PMU16:12:O7 15A -- AC relay coil drive (PHYS pin 10)
18 AWG. Red. PMU16 O7 (PHYS pin 10, 15A) → AC_RELAY_COIL_STUB (ac-compressor.wv AC_RELAY pin 86). Very low current -- relay coil only (~200mA). Replaces fuse block F10 feed.

g.title: BATT_NEG
g.text: TWO separate leads from battery negative terminal: Pin 1: 4 AWG welding cable → chassis stud (engine bay) -- W_BATT_NEG_CHASSIS Pin 2: 4 AWG welding cable → engine block directly -- W_BATT_NEG_ENGINE (dedicated run) Do NOT rely on engine-block-to-chassis strap to complete the battery ground path. Run both leads. Ring lug both ends. Welding cable preferred (EWCS 4 AWG or equiv).

g.title: W_BATT_NEG_CHASSIS
g.text: 4 AWG welding cable (EWCS). Black. Battery negative terminal → chassis stud (engine bay). Ring lug both ends. One of TWO ground leads from battery negative.

g.title: W_BATT_NEG_ENGINE
g.text: 4 AWG welding cable (EWCS). Black. Battery negative terminal → engine block ground stud directly. Ring lug both ends. SEPARATE from chassis lead. This is the critical direct-to-battery ground that eliminates ground offset and electrical noise. Do NOT merge with W_BATT_NEG_CHASSIS at either end. Route through cabin or alongside fuel pump run. P-clamp every 12 inches. Reference: StreetCarJoe Race Car Wiring Series Pt.2 (youtu.be/PNyScqftGQw)

g.title: CHASSIS_GND
g.text: Primary battery negative lead terminates here. PMU16 GND lug terminates here (W_PMU16_GND). Fan motor GND, condenser fan GND, and body electrical returns terminate here. E36 engine bay ground stud is on the strut tower or firewall. TODO: confirm exact stud location for this car. Keep M52 factory engine block-to-chassis bonding strap -- it provides the starter/alternator current return path from engine back to battery via chassis. Verify it is clean (no paint under lug, star washer, tight nut).

g.title: W_PMU16_GND
g.text: 4 AWG or 8 AWG welding cable. Black. PMU16 GND lug (body of unit) → chassis GND stud. Keep as short as possible. Ring lug both ends. Critical -- PMU16 output return currents all flow through this wire.

g.title: W_FAN_GND
g.text: FAN_MOTOR pin 2 :: chassis GND stud. 12 AWG. Return current path.

g.title: W_CONDENSER_FAN_GND
g.text: CONDENSER_FAN pin 2 :: chassis GND stud. 12 AWG.

g.title: ENGINE_BLOCK_GND
g.text: M8 bolt -- existing block boss or welded stud

Direct 4 AWG welding cable from battery negative terminal to engine block. This is a SEPARATE lead from the chassis ground -- do NOT merge these. Run both: battery→chassis AND battery→engine block (two cables, both 4 AWG). Ring lug both ends. Clean ground contact (no paint under lug). This eliminates the majority of race-car electrical noise/ground-offset issues. Separate from the M52 head-to-chassis strap (which stays in place for EMC). Reference: StreetCarJoe Race Car Wiring Series Pt.2 (youtube.com/watch?v=PNyScqftGQw)

g.title: IGN_12V_SOURCE
g.text: From ignition switch or X20 -- TODO confirm pin

Feeds PMU16 pin 7 (+12V SW) -- this is the PMU16 on/off sense input. When IGN is ON: PMU16 activates and begins executing programmed output logic. When IGN is OFF: PMU16 runs post-shutdown logic (e.g. EWP cooling) then powers down. TODO: confirm which ignition switch terminal or X20 pin carries key-on switched +12V for this RHD car. On E36, the ignition switch (pin 15) provides switched +12V. May be accessible at the fuse box or tapped from X20. Wire gauge: 18 AWG is sufficient (PMU16 +12V SW is a signal input, very low current).

g.title: W_IGN_TO_PMU16
g.text: 18 AWG. Red. IGN-switched +12V source → PMU16 39-pin pin 7 (+12V SW). Low current -- PMU16 on/off sense only. Fuse at source end: 5A.

g.title: MAXXECU_CAN1_STUB
g.text: PMU16 CAN2 (pins 24/34) connects to MaxxECU RACE CAN1H/CAN1L. Twisted pair cable, 22 AWG shielded. Drain at MaxxECU end only. Speed: must match on both sides. PMU16 CAN2 default = 500kbps or 1Mbit
(configure in PMU software). MaxxECU MTune: set CAN1 to same speed.
Bus termination: 120 ohm at each end. Enable PMU16 CAN2 software
termination in PMU config. Verify MaxxECU CAN1 has termination.
Cross-reference: maxxecu-m52.wv for ECU CAN1 physical pin assignment.

g.title: ECU_POWER_STUBS
g.text: Pin 7 (+12V ECU logic -- from PMU16 O1)

Both power pins must be supplied. Previously from relay outputs -- now from PMU16. Pin 1: coil and injector supply -- from PMU16 O2 (25A channel). Pin 7: ECU logic supply -- from PMU16 O1 (25A channel). See maxxecu-m52.wv for full 12-pin connector wiring. *** GROUND CRITICAL: MaxxECU GND pins (power GND and sensor GND) must run
directly to battery negative terminal -- not to chassis star point.
Using a chassis intermediate ground causes ground offsets that manifest
as sensor drift and ignition noise at high RPM.
Reference: StreetCarJoe Race Car Wiring Series Pt.2 (youtu.be/PNyScqftGQw) ***
*** COIL SECONDARY GROUND: Ignition coil packs need a secondary GND to the
cylinder head (one per coil bank) in addition to the main coil power/GND
running to the battery. Do not skip or merge with sensor ground path. ***

g.title: FAN_MOTOR
g.text: TODO: confirm SPAL fan model and connector. Common choice: SPAL 30102049 (12-inch puller, 15A single-speed). Phase 2 upgrade: SPAL 30102057 (PWM-capable) -- PMU16 O3 PWMs directly
to this fan, enabling variable speed control without any relay or driver.
Update output channel assignment in PMU config (frequency, duty table).
Fan GND to chassis GND stud (W_FAN_GND).

g.title: RADIUM_HANGER_STUB
g.text: Stub: PMU16 O4 → Radium 20-1170 hanger pump stud
See harnesses/fuel-pump-hanger.wv -- replaces Crydom D1D40 SSR
Pump+ stud (from PMU16 O4 PWM output)
PMU16 O4 (25A, PWM-capable) output connects to pump positive stud on Radium 20-1170 hanger, replacing the Crydom D1D40 DC SSR. TODO: update fuel-pump-hanger.wv to remove SSR -- wire PMU16 O4 directly
to pump+ stud. The Ctrl+/Ctrl- SSR wires to MaxxECU GPO are eliminated;
PWM duty is now commanded by MaxxECU over CAN to PMU16 channel O4.
Wire gauge: 12 AWG (Walbro F90000267 draws 14.1A max). See fuel-pump-hanger.wv for full hanger pinout and return wiring.

g.title: EWP_OUTPUT_STUB
g.text: Stub: PMU16 O5 → ewp-controller.wv CWA400 supply

PMU16 O5 output drives the EWP directly -- MAIN_RELAY in ewp-controller.wv is replaced. TODO: update ewp-controller.wv to remove internal relay and connect this wire directly to CWA400 Pin 3 (+12V supply input). CWA400 GND (Pin 4) still to chassis GND stud. ⚠️ CWA400 draws up to 35.5A nominal. PMU16 O5 is 25A max.
Resolve per TODO block at top of file before building this run.
Wire gauge: 10 AWG minimum (35.5A load; use 8 AWG if paralleling outputs). Post-shutdown cooling: PMU16 logic keeps O5 active after key-off per
programmed CLT threshold -- no separate power-hold relay needed.

g.title: CONDENSER_FAN
g.text: AC condenser fan. Must run whenever AC compressor is active. PMU16 O6 configured to activate when MaxxECU CAN signals AC on. TODO: confirm model. SPAL slimline or equivalent. Fan GND to chassis GND stud (W_CONDENSER_FAN_GND).

g.title: AC_RELAY_COIL_STUB
g.text: Stub: PMU16 O7 → ac-compressor.wv AC_RELAY coil pin 86

PMU16 O7 (15A) drives AC relay coil -- replaces fuse block F10 feed. Very low current (relay coil ~200mA); 18 AWG sufficient. TODO: update ac-compressor.wv to reference PMU16 O7 as coil power source. Condenser fan coil is no longer tapped from AC relay coil wire;
PMU16 O6 drives condenser fan directly (separate channel).
